title: Authentic Midlander Billet Recognition & Truncated Quantity Resolution
summary: Fixes Midlander Claymore Billet misidentifying as Riftborn Regalia by upgrading billet atlas icons to authentic in-game art, and fixes quantity reading truncation and false conflict alerts.

changes.text: Midlander Billet Recognition: replaced outdated beta silver icons with authentic dark in-game icons across all Midlander Billets (Claymore, Sword, Bow, Catalyst, Polearm), eliminating misidentification as Riftborn Regalia and restoring 100% recognition confidence.

Digit Stroke Boundary Segmentation: fixed footer text component merging to enforce vertical proximity and height constraints, preventing star-row artifacts from merging with and deleting adjacent digits.

Edge-Truncated Digit Classification & Multi-Frame Consensus: enhanced digit aspect checks and sliced template matching for edge-clipped numbers, and updated video scanner multi-frame voting to gracefully resolve partial-frame truncations without false 'Frames disagree on quantity' alerts.
Crop Thumbnail Preview: moved the 'Raw' indicator badge to the top-left corner in review dialogs so it never obscures footer numbers.
